claims.statement: Tom Allen deposited $200 with Mr. Carroll for a match with any man, and challenged Charley Gallagher to cover that deposit.
claims.excerpt: 1 have deposited two hundred dollars with Mr. Carrol! for a match with any man

claims.statement: Tom Allen said he would meet Charley Gallagher at any place Gallagher named, to draw up articles, if Gallagher covered the $200 deposit.
claims.excerpt: let him cover that amount, and I will meet him at any he may

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: and it he (Gallagher) vants a match let him cover that amount, and I will meet him at any he may hame to craw up articles.

notes: Letter printed in the paper, dated St. Louis, July 8, 1869.
